verdict.rationale: skills.sh has no dedicated export command. Its own storage model is open, though: skills are plain SKILL.md files (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown) written to project or user directories. The CLI runs without an account, a skills-lock.json manifest can restore installs, and skills work across any compatible agent, so leaving costs little. Missing for 10: a documented export or offboarding capability, any statement covering data held by the skills.sh site (e.g. leaderboard or install telemetry), and independent corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
